OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: OpenCTI entity types imported by the connector.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

WHOISFREAKS_API_BASE_URL.description: WhoisFreaks threat-feed stream API base URL.

WHOISFREAKS_FEED_TYPES.description: Threat feeds to import (subset of: malware, phishing, spam). Leave empty or omit feeds you are not subscribed to.

WHOISFREAKS_NRD_FEED_TYPES.description: NRD feeds to import. Valid values: nrd_gtld_with_whois, nrd_cctld_with_whois, nrd_gtld_without_whois, nrd_cctld_without_whois. Only enable feeds covered by your subscription.

WHOISFREAKS_NRD_BASE_URL.description: WhoisFreaks NRD stream API base URL.

WHOISFREAKS_PAGE_LIMIT.description: Number of CSV records requested per page. Higher values reduce HTTP overhead; keep within API limits and available memory (recommended 5000-10000 for large feeds).

WHOISFREAKS_NRD_TIMEOUT.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for NRD feed requests.

WHOISFREAKS_THREAT_TIMEOUT.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for threat-feed requests.

WHOISFREAKS_MAX_RETRIES.description: Max HTTP retries on transient errors (429/5xx).

WHOISFREAKS_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS.description: Base seconds for exponential backoff between retries.

WHOISFREAKS_CHECKPOINT_EVERY_PAGES.description: Update the in-memory offset every N pages; the connector persists state at the end of its callback.

WHOISFREAKS_IMPORT_SINCE.description: Latest-snapshot floor date; snapshots older than this date are skipped. This does not trigger historical backfill. Accepts an ISO-8601 date-time or relative duration such as P7D.

WHOISFREAKS_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to imported STIX objects.

WHOISFREAKS_CREATE_INDICATORS_FOR_NRD.description: When true, create Indicator + based-on for NRD domains. When false, only Domain-Name observables are created (recommended for high-volume NRD feeds).
